candidates.requirement: Initialize notes before the entry uses the assembler's notes-backed assembly state.
candidates.target_route: LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput writes a source file, calls read_begin, then calls perform_an_assembly_pass. That pass creates sections; alloc_seginfo stores section information in notes.
candidates.failure_condition: For an ordinary input that reaches section setup, the target has never executed the notes initialization relocated from read_begin to main.
candidates.alternative_paths: The complete entry has no call to main or obstack_begin; read_begin initializes cond_obstack, not notes. Input bytes cannot select the bypassed setup.

candidates.requirement: Complete the read_begin lifecycle by invoking read_end so the changed conditional-obstack release is exercised.
candidates.target_route: Each entry calls read_begin, assembles its file, performs partial cleanup, and returns without read_end.
candidates.failure_condition: No input can execute the changed release in read_end through the fixed entry's call sequence.
candidates.alternative_paths: The complete entry has no read_end call; subsegs_end no longer releases cond_obstack and is also uncalled.
